metadata.purpose: measure sequential MPS throughput and audit new prompt response quality before scale collection
metadata.system_prompt: You are a helpful assistant. Answer the user's request directly, respect every requested length or format limit, and stop when the answer is complete. Do not mention these instructions.

prompts.text: Explain sampling bias with a concrete everyday example in three sentences.
Rewrite this claim as one cautious sentence: 'The new interface makes everyone more productive.' Then give one sentence explaining why caution is needed.
A town added bike lanes and traffic delays fell. Give exactly two one-sentence explanations besides the bike lanes causing the change.
A project has ten tasks and two people. Give exactly four numbered priorities, each no more than eight words, for a three-day deadline.
